verdicts.photo_observation: Tracing the overlaid routing lines page by page: PV modules (roof, pages 15-16) -> wall hole (pages 16-17) -> 'Inverter and Accessories' wall box (page 17) -> down through a vertical service shaft behind a mesh grille with existing risers/conduit (pages 18-19) -> horizontal run along basement corridor ceiling conduit/trunking (pages 19-20) -> arrives at the main electrical panel room, terminating at labeled 'Main Meter' and 'Solar Meter' locations (page 21). A separate earthing run (green/orange overlay, pages 24-27) follows the same hole/shaft/corridor path and terminates at labeled 'AC Earth Pit', 'DC Earth Pit' and 'LA Pit' markers in the basement parking area (page 27).
verdicts.rationale: Both the power-cable and earthing-cable overlays connect continuously from the rooftop PV/inverter location through to clearly labeled termination points (main/solar meter, earth pits) with no dangling or unexplained endpoints, and the exposed indoor sections show existing conduit/trunking being used for the route. Note the colored lines are the designer's proposed routing overlaid on real background photos rather than an already-installed cable run, so continuity reflects the plan's internal consistency rather than an as-built cable.
